scope: 55 core expansion cities / 110 desktop and mobile images
method: Inspect generated originals, final asset contact sheets and actual rendered header samples; compare questionable landmark forms against the source research notes.
outcome: The reviewed final images retain identifying landmark forms, transparent backgrounds and the left-information/right-illustration header composition. Important landmark tips are inside the final frame. Foreground ground, foliage, water or boundary walls may continue to the canvas edges.
styleObservation: The shared dark outlines and pastel travel-illustration palette are consistent. Detail density varies by landmark; these are stylized destination illustrations rather than documentary architectural reconstructions.
provenance: All outputs use text-only generation with no image inputs. Superseded attempts and their prompts/source hashes are preserved in design/revisions.
